Retries the upload up to three times with backoff when the storage service
answers with a timeout.

Adds a test with a fake clock so the backoff is not slept in CI. No change to
the public API. The longer description lives in the linked issue, which an
agent does not need to decide what to do next.

## Testing

- Added unit tests for the retry loop with a fake clock.
- Ran the upload integration suite against a local storage emulator, with the
  emulator configured to time out on the first two attempts and succeed on the
  third, and again with it timing out on every attempt to check the give-up case.

## Rollout

Safe to ship behind the existing upload flag. If the retries mask a real
outage, the upload metric still counts each give-up once.
